fields.description: The marketplace's own id for this listing -- Flipkart calls it the FSN. Several can point at one Item: a marketplace mints a new one per listing, so variants and relistings of one product each carry their own.
fields.label: Channel Product ID

fields.description: The Item this listing resolves to. Blank means the SKU on the order has no Item here yet -- the mapping is still recorded, so it resolves on its own once the product is imported.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: The seller's own code for the listing, as the marketplace holds it. Often equals the SKU but not always, which is why both are kept.
fields.label: Seller SKU Code

fields.description: Unicommerce's own SKU from the order line. Kept alongside the Item so a mapping stays readable even if the Item is later renamed or removed.
fields.label: Unicommerce SKU

fields.description: Updated every time an order carries this listing, so a stale mapping is distinguishable from a live one.
fields.label: Last Seen On
